items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No

02. Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you posses in social science, institutional research or another relevant field: Please attach a copy of your degree or transcripts showing when degree was awarded or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree | Associate's degree | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree or higher

04. (MQ) Please select the level of progressively responsible experience you possess as a grant writer, research assistant or analyst: Options: Less than one (1) years' experience | One (1) year to less than two (2) years' experience | Two (2) to less than four (4) years' experience | Four (4) to less than six (6) years' experience | Six (6) or more years' experience

05. (MQ) Please describe your experience as a grant writer, research assistant or analyst. Please include the following: - Name of the employer(s) - Position title(s) you held - Type of duties: This information will also need to be identifiable in the work history portion of the application, or the application may be deemed incomplete.

06. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
